kind.content: We build for the teams who build.
Vantora started in a borrowed meeting room in Lisbon, with three people who were tired of guessing. Today 2,400 product teams use it to decide what to ship next.

kind.alt: Three Vantora team members gathered around a laptop in the studio at dusk

kind.content: Good products shouldn’t need a data team to prove it.

We started Vantora because every team we worked on had the same problem: the answers were in the data, but the data was three tickets away. We want the person who has the idea to be the person who can test it.
